client_brief:
FOLD & GRAIN Studio: Two hero sizzles and their platform sets

Project overview
FOLD & GRAIN shoots small brands' products the way those brands actually sell them, in a row, as a range, rather than one hero at a time. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Two hero sizzles and their platform sets, Two client house sets, brought to two opposed targets, and Cobbleway and Lunara shot boards plus the FOLD & GRAIN service page, as one editable document with its source.

What we will provide
source_video_files/ (2 measured short files); motion_source_metadata.json; cobbleway_grabs/ (24 frame exports, 3840 x 2160, four per carton); lunara_grabs/ (27 frame exports, three per piece); client_marks/ (two photographs: cobbleway_carton_face.jpg, lunara_bail_stamp.jpg); foldgrain_service_copy.txt. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Scope and deliverables
- Two hero sizzles and their platform sets: Two visually led 4-second sizzles, one per supplied client clip, plus one vertical reframe of each. 
- Two client house sets, brought to two opposed targets: Six Cobbleway carton masters brought to one bright, warm, honest target and nine Lunara pendant masters brought to a separate cool, restrained, dark target, each set holding one white point, one black point and one product scale within its own cells, plus...
- Cobbleway and Lunara shot boards plus the FOLD & GRAIN service page, as one editable document with its source: One professionally selected Adobe Express template adapted to the supplied brand, copy, and approved imagery. 

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Treat measured file duration and stream metadata as authoritative. Do not infer spoken content from silent clips or use a visual summary as a transcript.

Source-media note
The supplied package contains 2 video files totaling 10.084 seconds, 0 with embedded audio, and 0 separate audio files. These measured values are the production limits.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$5,000-$12,000 fixed; target delivery 4 to 6 weeks; direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Upwork post from a small packaging design studio launching a new website, asking for an 'eye-catching sizzle reel to be used as the hero video on my new site' that is 'fast paced and energetic while showcasing my design work in the best way possible', to be built from 'mockups and photographs of packaging projects I have completed'. Co-anchor: the Freelancer.com post from a growing direct to consumer sterling silver jewellery brand wanting a freelance editor to 'repurpose existing content into multiple formats and variations' for short form and social. Both posts are laundered: the studio becomes the coined FOLD & GRAIN Studio, its two client runs become the coined Cobbleway Provisions and Lunara Silver, and the ledger's non Western founder persona is replaced by Elodie Marchand. The STRENGTHEN verdict applies because the killed original sat almost entirely on one surface (reframe a clip, ship it) and because the ledger's own repositioning note concedes the original reframed an already vertical clip to vertical, a no operation that would also have enlarged. CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) changes what the honest fuller commission is: HTML authoring now yields a native editable document at mixed canvas sizes, an ink level trace off photographed printed collateral recovers a real mark, and the video family shortens and reframes but never enlarges. So this is the commission both clients genuinely needed, which is not a reel but a repeatable service proven twice at two different price bands.

price_band_and_audience: One engagement, two deliberately opposed client bands, plus the studio's own band. Cobbleway Provisions is pantry goods at roughly eight dollars a carton, bought off a shelf and off a small web store by a shopper aged twenty five to fifty five who decides in under two seconds: bright ground, generous product scale in the cell, warm honest colour, legible price, nothing precious. Lunara Silver is sterling pendants at roughly one hundred and eighty dollars, bought by a woman aged twenty eight to forty five who is buying restraint: dark stone ground, small product in a lot of air, cool restrained colour, no gloss, price set quietly. The band is load bearing twice over. Apply the bright generous treatment to the pendants and a one hundred and eighty dollar piece reads as costume, apply the restrained dark treatment to the cartons and eight dollar pantry goods read as unaffordable and stop selling. And because the whole pitch is a productized service, a single house look applied to both boards is not a stylistic slip, it is the proof failing: it demonstrates the studio cannot price tune, which is the one thing the service claims. FOLD & GRAIN itself bills around fifteen hundred dollars a day today and wants the product at a fixed twenty two hundred to three thousand five hundred dollars per client run. A posted job of this shape runs two thousand to four thousand five hundred dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: One take. Everything you need to sell it.
brand_identity.sector: Product photography studio moving from a day rate practice to a fixed price productized service
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2020 in Portland, Oregon. Three people: Nina (art direction and shooting), plus a retoucher and a studio assistant.
brand_identity.about: FOLD & GRAIN shoots small brands' products the way those brands actually sell them, in a row, as a range, rather than one hero at a time. For six years we sold days. We are now selling a product: one continuous take per client and, out of that single take, the shot board, the short films and the platform cuts a small brand needs to launch. Our work sits behind pantry goods at eight dollars and sterling silver at a hundred and eighty, and the whole point is that the same method tunes to each. Precision, repeatability and honesty about what a shoot can and cannot yield are the studio's stock in trade.
brand_identity.audience: Small and independent product brands (pantry, personal care, jewellery, homeware) launching or refreshing a web store and needing a full range shot to look like one afternoon. Founders who buy a fixed price and a fixed turnaround, not a day rate.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Repositioning from roughly fifteen hundred dollars a day to a fixed twenty two hundred to thirty five hundred dollars per client run. Mid-market, productized, premium to a freelancer but well under an agency.
brand_identity.typography: A clean neo-grotesque for headings and the studio wordmark, paired with a monospaced face for technical specs, parameters and captions on the service page. Type is set tight, quiet and utilitarian.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, specific, no salesmanship. We name what a shoot can deliver and what it cannot, and we write our recipes so an assistant could run them. Sentences are short and concrete.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: FOLD & GRAIN has a consistent working look built up over six years but never a codified system. There is a set wordmark and studio colours in practice, no written guidelines. This engagement, which includes the studio's own service page, is where the identity gets formalized for the first time.
brand_identity.values: Repeatability over one-off flourish, honesty about limits, and price-appropriate craft: a treatment right for one band is wrong for another, and saying so is the service.

assets_supplied.name: motion_source_metadata.json
assets_supplied.visible_description: Measured duration, stream, dimensions, frame-rate and audio-presence facts for every supplied motion file. This file is authoritative for edit planning.

assets_supplied.name: cobbleway_grabs/ (24 frame exports, 3840 x 2160, four per carton)
assets_supplied.kind: The assistant's on set frame exports pulled off that take, four per carton, straight out of the camera with nothing applied.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Four grabs per carton, straight off the take, nothing done to them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The window went behind cloud partway through the take and the operator re balanced the camera without saying so, so roughly half the grabs sit cooler than the rest, and the split is invisible on any single frame and only appears once six cartons are laid in a row. Two of the six cartons have grabs only from the cooler half, so bringing those two to the warmer family is a different move from correcting the other four.

assets_supplied.name: lunara_grabs/ (27 frame exports, three per piece)
assets_supplied.kind: Three frame exports per pendant off the same take, each piece caught at a slightly different point in the slider crawl.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Three grabs per piece, take your pick."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Which of a piece's three grabs sits under the clip is a property of how that individual piece happened to be lying on the slab, so the usable index is different for every one of the nine and cannot be predicted from the file order. Two of the nine pieces have no usable grab at all, which no filename, no folder and no preview reveals.

assets_supplied.name: client_marks/ (two photographs: cobbleway_carton_face.jpg, lunara_bail_stamp.jpg)
assets_supplied.kind: The only surviving evidence of each client's mark. One is a printed wordmark in a single deep ink on kraft board, photographed flat on a bench. The other is a macro of the maker's stamp punched into the bail of a pendant.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Neither of them has the file any more. This is all that is left."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: They look like the same job and they are not: the printed one is ink on a substrate and traces, while the punched one carries no ink at all and exists only as the shadow inside a deformation in polished metal, so the route that works on the first returns a plausible looking blob on the second. The printed wordmark is also set in small caps with a hairline bracket on the serifs, which survives at canvas size and does not survive at the size the mark actually reproduces in a board caption strip.

assets_supplied.name: foldgrain_service_copy.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Plain text: the studio's own service description and turnaround, both clients' product names and prices as they must appear, and the caption copy for each board cell.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The words as they go out. Prices are current and cannot be edited."

verifiers_auto.text: Each sizzle is shorter than the take it came from, and each platform variant's dimensions are at or below what its source can supply.
verifiers_auto.how: Compare each sizzle's duration against its take's duration, and each variant's dimensions against the source frame size.

verifiers_process.text: No crop, resize or reframe tradeoff record captured in the run carries an enlargement entry, and every reduction entry is transcribed into the service pack.
verifiers_process.how: Diff the tradeoff objects captured from every image and video call against the resize table in the pack.

verifiers_process.text: The export returned three roots, each keeping its own declared canvas size.
verifiers_process.how: Read the slide count and the per slide width and height in the export response.

verifiers_process.text: Every text element in the exported markup carries a resolved licensed PostScript face rather than a fallback default.
verifiers_process.how: Read the font family attribute on every text node in the returned markup and check it against the families the kit call returned.

verifiers_human.text: The walk through either carries as voice a client would put on their own site, or it is absent and the pack says why.
verifiers_human.how: Listen to the enhanced audio at the level a site hero plays at and read the decision in the pack.

verifiers_human.text: Both sizzles hold attention and neither opens on, cuts to, or ends on dead footage.
verifiers_human.how: Watch each sizzle end to end against the content map made from the take summary.

verifiers_human.text: The service page reads as a studio worth two thousand two hundred to three thousand five hundred dollars a run rather than as a day rate photographer's rate card.
verifiers_human.how: Judge the page's restraint, type scale and the quality of the licensed band against the productized positioning.

verifiers_human.text: The recipe could actually be run next Tuesday by someone who was not on this job, including the parts where it can silently go wrong.
verifiers_human.how: Read the pack as the assistant would, checking that each step names its parameters, its decision and its failure mode, and that every limitation is stated.

why_not_vlm: A generated video would replace the supplied people, products, interfaces, locations, and finite recorded actions rather than edit them. This task is scored on traceability to measured source ranges, final framing, and truthful use of separate audio, which a newly generated clip cannot satisfy.

doability_proof.status: doable with the current ChatGPT Adobe connector profile and declared exception paths
proof: Every required operation is present in the captured 99-tool ChatGPT Adobe inventory.
The client brief is host-neutral; connector-specific scoring is isolated in connector_profile and verifier_contract.
Artifact acceptance never depends on a raw connector response field.
Unsupported truth, fabrication, press, legal, or color claims have an explicit defer or disclose state.
residual_limits: Express work is template adaptation, not unrestricted canvas authoring.
Quick Cut is used only for visually led selection and never as semantic speech editing.
Automatic vectorization does not independently establish fabrication readiness.
Interactive Acrobat page-organization operations are excluded from zero-human execution.

acceptance_bar_note: The acceptance bar applies only to the scoped deliverables above. Hidden defects and connector quirks remain benchmark-internal and are not leaked into the client-facing brief.
